findings.title: Close REFERENCES permission for public organizations before authority definitions
evidence: Decoded approval SQL creates projection_activations.organization_id PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.zasp_organizations(id).
Canonical0007 creates public.zasp_organizations under the migration operator; inspected numbered source contains no transfer of its owner to zasp_discovery_authority.
Canonical0079 projection SQL line209 grants SELECT on organizations/workspaces/environments to authority, not REFERENCES. No numbered SQL REFERENCES grant found.
Authority-owned definitions therefore require an additional exact organizations(id) REFERENCES prerequisite; SELECT does not confer FOREIGN KEY creation rights.
findings.relatedEvidence: Connector projection_activations has the same public organizations foreign key and authority installation constraint.
findings.remedyConstraint: Observe exact native owner/column privileges and existing closed catalog association first. Any reviewed installer prerequisite must add only REFERENCES(id) on exactly public.zasp_organizations to exactly zasp_discovery_authority under registered operator, if required; no ALL, DML, public/API/worker grants. Refuse incompatible catalog instead of updating immutable fingerprints to accept arbitrary privilege changes. Explicitly version/pin dependency successor and prove predecessor readiness/noninterference.

unsupportedHypotheses: Missing REFERENCES on public.zasp_security_agent_approval_notifications is not supported: canonical0030 line39 transfers that table to authority, so owner has REFERENCES.
No specific missing temporal namespace privilege found: reviewed private schemas/functions are authority-owned.
